message:
The other night, we had an unexpected power outage. At first, it felt a bit unsettling, but then I remembered my trusty flashlights and battery-powered lanterns tucked away in the closet. I gathered up some snacks and a few blankets, and we turned the living room into a cozy little hideaway. 

We played cards by lantern light and shared stories like we were camping in the living room! It was a nice reminder that even when things go dark, we can create our own warmth and comfort. 

What’s your go-to trick for making a blackout feel a little brighter?
